authorization: Wave 5D Route 2 permits exactly one materially new bargaining-only Model-A v2 formulation. Extraction and fit require a fresh independent all-pass audit plus the separate root token.

candidate.factorization: coherent binary chain P(offer), P(accept|response), P(walkaway|nonaccept response), a separately censored stop hazard, and conditional empirical-residual offer distribution
candidate.solver: frozen Wave-5C deterministic ridge primitives reused only after v2 extraction and v2 selection
candidate.tie_break: larger ridge, then shorter history, then fewer residual bins

censoring.complete_terminal: accept, walkaway, or reject at the explicit public horizon
censoring.right_censored: all other last observed actions, including an offer at the public horizon with a missing response callback
censoring.row_hazard_rule: observed pre-censor non-stop rows remain eligible; the last censored row has no stop target
censoring.trajectory_rule: right-censored games never receive terminal-round or action-count targets; complete and censored support is reported separately

operational_v1.implementation: execute pinned sample_opponent_spec plus BargainingPolicy for every Monte-Carlo draw

comparators.simple_role_intercept: training-only Jeffreys action/stop and empirical-offer baseline

feature_visibility.configuration_source: nonempty public_parameters only; private configuration fallback is fatal
feature_visibility.private_information_rule: deltas enter only when complete_information is true and the fields exist in public_parameters
feature_visibility.target_boundary: features at t use only public configuration and validated transcript_so_far through t-1
transcript_guards: integer nondecreasing rounds no later than target round

folds_and_selection.actor_axis: three frozen acting-identity folds from build_manifest; held-out identity effects exactly zero
folds_and_selection.config_axis: four frozen public-config hash folds; held-out config effects exactly zero
folds_and_selection.inner_objective: within each game, mean loss per available action/observed-stop/observed-offer channel, then equal mean across available channels; equal unweighted mean across all validation games pooled over folds
folds_and_selection.outer_rule: each stable row identity scored exactly once on actor and once on config axes

jordan_reached_diagnostics.mae_rule: candidate normalized MAE minus exact operational-v1 MAE below zero on both axes
jordan_reached_diagnostics.coverage_rule: candidate central-80 coverage within [0.75,0.85] on both axes
jordan_reached_diagnostics.selection_role: diagnostic only; never model selection or live evidence

model_definition: P(next bargaining action, offer distribution and censor-aware stop hazard | acting role's strictly public pre-action history through t-1)
post_outcome_change_policy: Any model, feature, target, censoring, row identity, split, grid, seed, comparator, diagnostic, threshold, audit-gate, supervisor, or code-hash change after independent pre-fit review terminates this formulation. No third formulation is authorized in Wave 5D.

row_identity.duplicate_rule: fatal during extraction and OOF reconciliation
row_identity.observational_event_id_role: retained only for provenance; may be empty and never defines identity

supervisor.address_space_backstop: Linux RLIMIT_AS plus mandatory aggregate RSS polling; Darwin mandatory libproc aggregate RSS polling because finite RLIMIT_AS is not supported on the runner
supervisor.artifact_monitor: aggregate bytes under the new output root, plus extraction pre-write ceiling
supervisor.cpu_backstop: RLIMIT_CPU equal to effective monotonic budget times six workers
supervisor.deadline: monotonic budget capped by fixed 2026-08-17T11:50:34Z safe-shutdown boundary
supervisor.memory_monitor: independent process-tree RSS via Darwin libproc or Linux procfs
supervisor.restart: none; preexisting certificate or nonempty output is fatal
supervisor.termination: process-group SIGTERM, bounded grace, then SIGKILL
supervisor.worker_limit: aggregate process-tree thread count at most six plus numerical-library environment caps
supervisor.write: single fsync-backed atomic terminal certificate on every spawned-child terminal path
